methods.label: Coordinate magnitudes and quadrant signs
methods.explanation: The distance to the y-axis is \(5\), so \(|a|=5\). The distance to the x-axis is \(2\), so \(|b|=2\). In the fourth quadrant, the x-coordinate is positive and the y-coordinate is negative, so \(a=5\) and \(b=-2\).
